rooms.name: Foot of the cliff
rooms.desc: Rocky slopes at the foot of the abbey's cliff, the village of Krezk below.
rooms.dm: Not an area of the abbey: the ground 400 ft below the ledge, kept so the cliffs and the switchback road read.

objects.label: The village floor, 400 ft below the abbey: anything that falls over the south-west wall lands on these slopes. The switchback road (S5) starts here.

rooms.name: Main Hall
rooms.desc: A fifty-foot hall with arched leaded windows: a cauldron over the hearth under a golden sun disk, a long table set with wooden dishes and gold candelabras, a wooden stair up in one corner, a stone stair down in another. Soft music drifts from above.
rooms.dm: The Abbot and Vasilka. The soup (turnip and rabbit) feeds the mongrelfolk. Sun disk 750 gp, four candelabras 250 gp each; the niche behind the disk.

rooms.name: Courtyard
rooms.desc: A courtyard full of swirling fog inside fifteen-foot walls lined with scarecrows. A winched stone well in the middle, padlocked sheds and trough alcoves under the walls, two tethering posts; screams from the sheds.
rooms.dm: Doors north to the main hall and east to the foyer. Otto and Zygfrek leave escorted guests here while they fetch the Abbot.

rooms.name: Inner Gatehouse (north)
rooms.desc: A small empty stone building under the curtain wall, an unlocked wooden door into the courtyard.
rooms.dm: Both gatehouses help hold up the wall; nothing inside.

rooms.name: Inner Gatehouse (south)
rooms.desc: The second empty gatehouse under the curtain wall.
rooms.dm: Nothing inside.

rooms.name: Abbey Entrance
rooms.desc: Between the two wings a fifteen-foot wall with straw "sentries" on its battlements; tall steel-banded doors and a green copper plaque beside them.
rooms.dm: The plaque names the abbey with a short prayer for the healing of the sick. The doors push open on the foggy courtyard.

rooms.name: Well
rooms.desc: A stone well with an iron winch, a rope and a bucket.
rooms.dm: Eighty feet deep; Mishka Belview clings to the shaft twenty feet down and comes up at anyone who shines a light on him.

rooms.name: Old Troughs
rooms.desc: Three shallow alcoves under the wall, each with a rotting wooden horse trough.
rooms.dm: The troughs fall apart if handled.

rooms.name: Tethering Posts
rooms.desc: Two hitching posts ringed with iron; chained to one, a small winged thing with a spider's jaws.
rooms.dm: Marzena Belview: skittish, flees for good if her chains are broken or unlocked.

rooms.name: Chicken Shed
rooms.desc: A padlocked stone shed: smashed chicken coops and a creature shackled to the back wall.
rooms.dm: Nine sheds, each holding a mongrelfolk; Clovin has the keys.

rooms.name: Chicken Shed
rooms.desc: A padlocked stone shed.
rooms.dm: A shackled mongrelfolk among smashed coops; Clovin carries the padlock keys.

rooms.desc: A padlocked stone shed.
rooms.dm: A shackled mongrelfolk among smashed coops; Clovin carries the padlock keys.

rooms.desc: A padlocked stone shed against the hall.

rooms.dm: A shackled mongrelfolk among smashed coops; Clovin carries the padlock keys.

rooms.name: Chicken Shed
rooms.desc: A padlocked stone shed under the south wall.
rooms.dm: A shackled mongrelfolk among smashed coops; Clovin carries the padlock keys.

rooms.desc: A padlocked stone shed under the south wall.
rooms.dm: A shackled mongrelfolk among smashed coops; Clovin carries the padlock keys.

rooms.name: Chicken Shed
rooms.desc: A padlocked stone shed under the south wall.
rooms.dm: A shackled mongrelfolk among smashed coops; Clovin carries the padlock keys.

rooms.name: Chicken Shed
rooms.desc: A padlocked stone shed against the east wing.
rooms.dm: A shackled mongrelfolk among smashed coops; Clovin carries the padlock keys.

rooms.name: Foyer
rooms.desc: Once an office: a smashed desk and chair. A hall runs south to a stair going up; a dark passage east whispers and laughs and stinks.
rooms.dm: Noise or light here draws the flesh golem from S15. The stair climbs to S20.

rooms.name: Madhouse
rooms.desc: A black corridor lined with doors, laughter and muttered curses behind every one, and a reek that catches the throat; a door at the far end lets onto the gardens.
rooms.dm: The flesh golem paces here. Sixty mongrelfolk in the cells, unrestrained but too afraid to leave; each has a dagger and a wooden soup bowl.

rooms.name: Fearful Mongrelfolk
rooms.desc: A smashed dormitory; three figures huddle shrieking in the north-west corner, one hugging something that glints.
rooms.dm: Three mongrelfolk; the brass candlestick.

rooms.name: Quarreling Mongrelfolk
rooms.desc: Four creatures wrestle in the wreckage while a fifth giggles from behind a painted wooden saint.
rooms.dm: Five mongrelfolk; the statue of Saint Markovia is covered with bite marks.

rooms.name: Incanting Mongrelfolk
rooms.desc: Seven figures squat in a circle, droning what sounds like a spell.
rooms.dm: Seven mongrelfolk speaking gibberish, trying to ring the dinner bell by magic.

rooms.name: Hungry Mongrelfolk
rooms.desc: Nine gaunt figures wait in silence, eyes fixed hungrily on the door.
rooms.dm: Nine starved mongrelfolk attack anyone who enters.

rooms.name: Mongrelfolk Horde
rooms.desc: A crush of misshapen bodies fills the room, filthy, among chewed bones.
rooms.dm: Sixteen mongrelfolk; the bones are their dead.

rooms.name: Singing and Dancing Mongrelfolk
rooms.desc: Eight figures dance and chant through the wreckage behind a leader waving a gold figurine.
rooms.dm: Eight mongrelfolk; the gold statuette of Saint Markovia.

rooms.name: Mongrelfolk Babies
rooms.desc: Wailing infants are rocked in the corners while the rest roll about, hooting and beating one another with sticks.
rooms.dm: Ten mongrelfolk, three tending noncombatant babies.

rooms.name: Mongrelfolk Fort
rooms.desc: Smashed furniture and torn curtains heaped into a den; someone giggles inside it.
rooms.dm: Two mongrelfolk inside (three-quarters cover); they come out only for food.

objects.label: S6 North Gate (Krezk map): two stone guard posts and squealing iron gates; Otto and Zygfrek Belview asleep under furs. A net of twigs and a shovel on each inside wall.
S7 Graveyard (Krezk map): stunted pines, the graves of priests and nuns (Brother Martek, Brother Valen, Sister Constance, Sister Lenora); beyond the low wall the ground falls away 400 ft.
S9 Gardens (Krezk map): four plots behind a five-foot wall, white rabbits, two scarecrows on crosses. The door to S15 is not locked.
Behind the sun disk (750 gp): a niche with a potion of superior healing in a crystal and electrum flask (250 gp); a card-reading treasure would be here too
Mishka Belview (CE mongrelfolk, spider climb) clinging to the shaft 20 ft down; scuttles up at anyone who shines a light down. The well is 80 ft deep.
Marzena Belview (CN mongrelfolk, flight), chained to the post: beats her wings and shrieks gibberish at anyone near; only Clovin may come close to feed her
A howling, mewling mongrelfolk shackled to the back wall among smashed coops (Clovin carries the padlock keys)

The "guards" on the battlements are scarecrows in corroded chain shirts (DC 10 Perception sees it). The doors are heavy but unlocked.
The flesh golem paces the lightless hall; it attacks anyone not with the Abbot or Clovin, and comes to noise or light in the foyer
Three mongrelfolk huddle in the north-west corner; one nurses a brass candlestick like a doll
Four mongrelfolk brawl for dominance (they stop if separated); a fifth cackles behind the statue
Seven mongrelfolk in a ring, chanting gibberish to make the dinner bell ring
Nine starved mongrelfolk staring at the door; they try to kill and eat whoever steps in
Sixteen filthy mongrelfolk among chewed bones, begging for food
Eight mongrelfolk capering and singing the rhyme of the devil and his bride; the leader holds up a gold statuette
Ten mongrelfolk; three tend screaming mongrelfolk babies (noncombatants), the rest roll about and whack each other with sticks
Two mongrelfolk hide in the fort (three-quarters cover); they come out only for food
A polished brass candlestick cradled like a doll; trying to take it makes them attack
A gold statuette of Saint Markovia (250 gp; +1 to saving throws for a good-aligned bearer); they weep if it is taken

The Abbot: a deva in a handsome young man's guise, teaching Vasilka etiquette. Friendly visitors get a tour and his help (raise dead up to three times) for a bridal gown; threats bring out his angelic form.
Vasilka, a flesh golem made to be Strahd's bride; within 5 ft the seams show. Obeys the Abbot, screams if harmed.

X: the sun's grave, carved with roses, a 3-inch sun-shaped hollow on its east side over the name PETROVNA. Tasha Petrovna's holy symbol (K84 crypt 11) in the hollow: a ray of sun, the stone crumbles, a ring of regeneration inside. Smashed without it: nothing.
Otto Belview (LE mongrelfolk, standing leap), asleep under furs; squats, brays when he laughs, and thinks himself the finest creature alive
Zygfrek Belview (LE mongrelfolk, darkvision), asleep under furs; scaled on one side, furred on the other, and sure everyone is judging her
The southernmost scarecrow: a card-reading treasure in its straw gullet; taking it raises seven wights in Strahd's tattered livery from the beds.
White rabbits nibbling turnips uprooted by the cold (harmless)
White rabbits nibbling turnips uprooted by the cold (harmless)

rooms.name: Curtain Wall (north walk)
rooms.desc: A walk behind the battlements, its garrison of straw men in rusted mail staring out over the cliffs; fog fills the yard below.
rooms.dm: A fifteen-foot drop into the courtyard; over the south-west wall, four hundred feet down the cliff.

rooms.name: Curtain Wall (west walk)
rooms.desc: The wall-walk along the west side of the courtyard.
rooms.dm: Scarecrows on stands; a 15-ft drop to the courtyard.

rooms.name: Curtain Wall (south-west walk)
rooms.desc: The wall-walk along the south-west wall; beyond the battlements the cliff falls away.
rooms.dm: A fall over this wall is 400 ft.

rooms.name: Curtain Wall (south walk)
rooms.desc: The wall-walk along the south wall.
rooms.dm: Scarecrows on stands; the cliff below.

rooms.name: Curtain Wall (east walk)
rooms.desc: The wall-walk along the east wing's end, doors into the upper floor.
rooms.dm: Doors into S20 and the stair hall; the madhouse below.

rooms.name: Curtain Wall (north-east walk)
rooms.desc: The wall-walk over the entrance and the two gatehouses.
rooms.dm: The scarecrow "guards" seen from the road stand here, over the doors.

rooms.name: Upstairs Office
rooms.desc: A big office behind an L-shaped counter; the rest of its furniture has mouldered into heaps.
rooms.dm: The counter is soft and breaks easily. The madhouse can be heard below.

rooms.name: Barracks
rooms.desc: The old guardroom: thirty feet square, damp, its bunks rotted into heaps.
rooms.dm: The old guards' quarters. Ezmerelda may be here.

rooms.name: Haunted Hospital
rooms.desc: A long ward of wrought-iron bed frames in two rows, cobwebs and rotten mattress on each; three doors in the south wall with plaques.
rooms.dm: Six shadows. The plaques read Operating Room, Nursery and Morgue.

rooms.name: Operating Room
rooms.desc: Bare but for a table dark with old blood.
rooms.dm: The screams on first touch.

rooms.name: Nursery
rooms.desc: Broken cribs, splintered and heaped.
rooms.dm: The nun in the window.

rooms.name: Morgue
rooms.desc: Bare boards, and a raven watching from the sill.
rooms.dm: The cursed raven.

objects.label: Ezmerelda d'Avenir (if not met elsewhere), the Abbot's guest, waiting for Strahd to visit his bride; plans a magic circle here
Six shadows wait until someone is 10 ft inside, then step out of the ordinary shadows; they cannot leave the room
The first touch of the table: a scream echoing through time, then fainter screams of those who died under the knife.
Searching: one character sees a nun in white reflected in the window glass, standing in the doorway; nothing is there. A card-reading treasure lies under a crib.
A raven on the windowsill: approached, it flies to the nearest garden scarecrow. Killing it curses the killer (disadvantage on attacks and checks until remove curse)

rooms.name: Loft and Belfry
rooms.desc: A loft under a pitched roof: unlit lanterns in the rafters, a rope from the bell thirty feet up, a shrouded shape on a table, a fur-heaped cot among empty bottles and a lamp-lit table, a viol playing. Freezing cold.
rooms.dm: The Abbot's golem workshop and Clovin's room. Ringing the bell sets every mongrelfolk shrieking for food. The door in the south wall opens on the wall-walk.

objects.label: Under the shroud: the characters see a creature stitched from their own parts; touched, it is chopped-up parts of dead women from Krezk's graves, the leftovers of Vasilka
Under the furs of the cot: three bottles of Purple Grapemash No. 3
Clovin Belview (two-headed NE mongrelfolk), drunk on the edge of his cot playing the viol beautifully; the Abbot's manservant, rings the dinner bell, carries the shed keys
T: where characters teleporting from K78 in Castle Ravenloft arrive.

rooms.name: Wine Cellar
rooms.desc: A cold stone cellar at the foot of a twenty-foot stair: wine barrels in rows and an L of racks crammed with bottles.
rooms.dm: Barrels marked with the Wizard of Wines; the scroll bottle on the rack.

objects.label: On the rack: an unstoppered bottle labelled "Champagne du le Stomp" holding a rolled spell scroll of heroes' feast
Centre barrels empty; east wall: Purple Grapemash No. 3 (cheap); south wall: Red Dragon Crush (fine). The racks hold 33 Grapemash and 24 Red Dragon Crush.
